content.value: Design an UJT relaxation oscillator circuit. An UJT has 12V between the bases. If the (08) intrinsic stand-off ratio is 2/3, find the value of stand-off voltage. What will be the peak point voltage if the forward drop in the p-n junction is 0.7V?
